claims.assertion: Mari Swa says Antarians planned to join the Alcyone-Urmah treaty, expanding the group’s cooperation.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: The signing was scheduled for October 20, 2024, in her account.

claims.assertion: Mari reports 14 starships under construction in Toleka and says she assigned a new Hyades-class destroyer to Earth orbit.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She links the expansion to Taygetan security concerns.

review_flags: The source describes unverified extraterrestrial diplomatic and military activity.
coverage_gaps: It also describes reported respiratory illness, shipyard expansion, and agriculture.
